units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:6:2">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵈ</cite> top <he>איזהו ח׳ קברים</he> what finishing of tombs (is meant in the Mishn. ib. 6)?

<cite ref="Menachot 78a:9">Men. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>חִינּוּכוֹ</he> his inauguration as a common priest, contrad. to <he>המשחו</he> his anointment as highpriest. Y. Shek. VI, 50ᵈ top <he>חִינּוּכוֹ</he> his (the highpriest’s) inauguration.

senses.gloss: gradual introduction of children into religious practice, training.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 82a:7">Yoma 82ᵃ</cite> <he>אי זה ח׳</he> wherein does the child’s training (to fast on the Day of Atonement) consist?—
<cite ref="Yoma 82a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ומי קרי לח׳ השלמה</he> is fasting the entire day called initiation?—
<cite ref="Nazir 29a:9">Naz. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ מדרבנן</he> the training of minors for religious practices is a rabbinically ordained duty; a. e.
